name: Brimline Palm
description: Strike with a palm held at the level of a brimming basin so the blow spills evenly across the target.

name: Brimline Ward
description: Hold a guard whose surface stays level however hard a blow strikes into it.

name: Brimline Step
description: Move one step with the weight carried like a full basin that must not spill.

name: Brimline Hold
description: Hold the opponent's limbs at the brim of his strength so that any further effort spills his hold.

name: Brimline Mend
description: Fill an ally's wounded body from the level of the user's own until both stand even.

name: Brimline Parry
description: Tip the guard to let a strike run over the brim and off to the side.

name: Even Floodtide
description: Raise a tide that rises and falls along the river until every foe stands in the same depth.

name: Silt Settling
description: Let heavy silt settle round the allies so that it seals the field and shields them from harm.

name: Level Deluge
description: Pour the full river onto the field in a deluge that presses every force down to the same level.

name: Level Accord
description: The school's closing move that brings basin and river level over the field with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Accord Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries both tracks of force at once and lands them in accord.

name: Accord Ward
description: Draw two tracks of qi across each other before the body into a ward that holds still.

name: Accord Glide
description: Glide down the point where two tracks meet and let their pulls carry the body forward.

name: Accord Cast
description: Cast two thin beads on both tracks that meet at the target and strike as one.

name: Accord Reading
description: Read the two tracks of force in a field and where they pull against each other.

name: Accord Seal
description: Draw the foe's two opposing flows of qi together into stillness and seal them.

name: Accord Mend
description: Bring an ally's injured flow of qi into accord with the sound flow until the wound closes.

name: Accord Parry
description: Turn a strike along the meeting of the tracks and let its force die at the join.

name: Crown Settling
description: Bring the tracks to the crown of the head and settle their weight on the foe in one blow.

name: Accord Mantle
description: Wrap the allies in a mantle of two tracks in accord that shields them and levels their strength.

name: Crowned Equilibrium
description: Hold the crown in perfect equilibrium over the field so that opposing techniques cancel and sink.

name: Accord Crown
description: The school's crowning move that sets both tracks in lasting accord above the field with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Meansworn Palm
description: Strike with a palm sworn to the mean so that the blow is neither too hard nor too soft.

name: Meansworn Ward
description: Hold a ward sworn to the mean that gives neither before the gust nor against it.

name: Meansworn Pace
description: Keep a sworn even pace into the wind that does not hasten at a gust or lag in a lull.

name: Gust Levelling
description: Level the foe's wild motion to a still calm with an even draft laid across him.

name: Mean Rinse
description: Wash an ally in an even wind to clear the lopsided taint of poison or curse.

name: Windcalm Mend
description: Bring a calm wind to an ally's wound to ease the heat of the injury and close it.

name: Mean Parry
description: Turn aside a strike with the sworn mean and leave the user's balance unchanged.

name: Wind Evening
description: Spread an even wind across the field that smooths storm and calm into one steady level.

name: Meansworn Mantle
description: Cover the sworn allies in a mantle of the mean that shields them and evens their power.

name: Mean Judgment
description: Judge the foe by the sworn mean and return the exact harm he has done through every guard.

name: Mean Covenant
description: The school's closing move that cancels hostile techniques and steadies allies with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Bedrock Palm
description: Strike with a palm that draws its force up from the dead level of the ground.

name: Bedrock Ward
description: Sink the stance to bedrock level and let a blow spend itself upon the whole ground.

name: Bedrock Tread
description: Walk with each foot set down at the same depth so the body never leans.

name: Bedrock Hold
description: Draw the opponent down to the ground's level and hold him there with an even weight.

name: Plumb Mend
description: Draw a plumb line down an ally's wounded body and bring the crooked flesh upright.

name: Bedrock Parry
description: Pass a strike down into the ground so that its force is lost in the bedrock.

name: Deep Settling
description: Settle the whole weight of the field down toward the bedrock and press every foe flat.

name: Deep Canopy
description: Spread a level canopy rooted in the bedrock over allies that guards them and mends their hurts.

name: Deep Equilibrium
description: Take the surging force of the field down into the bedrock and press the raging foes still.

name: Final Level
description: The school's deepest move that levels all rise and fall in the field at once with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.
